---
title: "ecm.credential_baseline"
description: "FY25-26 average active credentials, one row per ECM application."
---

The size of each ECM application before CanadaLogin, as ECM's average active
credentials over FY25-26.

One row is one ECM application. It joins to [`rp.alias`](../rp/alias.qmd) on
`ecm_service = alias`, and from there to [`rp.service`](../rp/service.qmd).

`Keywords`: ECM, External Credential Management, GCKey, Interac, ISI, baseline, active credentials, legacy volume replaced, FY25-26

## Provenance

The counts come from ECM's `VendorData` reporting database. One query covered
applications that sign in directly with GCKey or Interac. The other covered
applications behind the GC Credential Federation. This table merges the two
results into one row per application. The table is static and is not refreshed.
See the [ECM](../ecm.qmd) page.

* **Updated**: Static
* **Retention**: Indefinitely
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Colin Douglas](mailto:colin.douglas@cds-snc.ca)
* **Location**: `s3://canadalogin-reporting-transformed/ecm/credential_baseline/`

## Fields

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ecm_service` | `string` | The ECM application, as named in the ECM reporting database. |
| `ecm_service_id` | `string` | ECM's identifier for the application. |
| `department` | `string` | The department that owns the application. |
| `gckey_credentials` | `integer` | Average active GCKey credentials per month over FY25-26. |
| `isi_credentials` | `integer` | Average active Interac Sign-In Service credentials per month over FY25-26. |
| `active_credentials` | `integer` | Average active credentials per month over FY25-26, GCKey and ISI together. This is the application's ECM size. |

## Notes

**The period is FY25-26, April 2025 to March 2026.** Each credential column is
the average of ECM's monthly active credentials over those 12 months.

**Active credentials is ECM's billing measure, not monthly users.** A GCKey
credential is active if it was used in the last two years. An Interac credential
is active if it was used in the last 12 months.

**Each credential belongs to the first application it was used at.** ECM calls
this "first through the door". Counts across applications add up to ECM's total
without overlap.

**`active_credentials` can differ from `gckey_credentials + isi_credentials`.**
Each average is rounded on its own.

**Join to `rp.alias` with a left join from this table.** An ECM application has
an alias only once a CanadaLogin service has replaced it, so an inner join drops
the rest. An application with several aliases returns one row per alias, so
aggregate after the join and count each `ecm_service` once.

```sql
SELECT b.ecm_service,
       b.active_credentials,
       s.service_name_en
FROM ecm.credential_baseline b
LEFT JOIN rp.alias a ON b.ecm_service = a.alias
LEFT JOIN rp.service s ON a.rp_id = s.rp_id
```
